newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut shares mixed, turnover down.
newsitem.headline: Beirut shares mixed, turnover down.

text.p: Shares were mixed in lower turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
Banque Audi held steady at $17 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce fell to $12.5 from $12.625.
Solidere A was unchanged at $10.5 and B fell to $10.75 from $10.875.
The BLOM index dropped 0.35 percent to 906.11 and the LISPI stock index fell 0.21 percent to 81.37.
Also traded were 3,000 Eternit shares at $1.625, the price at which they last traded on July 2.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic .

Turnover in Banque Audi fell to 14,010 from 31,427 on Tuesday. It included a block trade of 3,036 shares at $17 on the floor of the bourse. Some 5,651 BLC shares were traded, down from Tuesday's 11,000.
Total BSE turnover was 79,847 shares for a value of $912,277 from Tuesday's 89,305 shares and $1,167,454.5.
